facts.claim: Approval route needs CLINE_TOOL_APPROVAL_MODE=desktop AND CLINE_TOOL_APPROVAL_DIR; without the dir or a session id every gated call is denied ('Desktop tool approval IPC is not configured')
Desktop approval applies only to non-interactive runAgent (prompt or piped stdin); interactive TUI uses its own approver; ACP mode uses its own

Request file path <DIR>/<sessionId>.request.<requestId>.json, decision file <DIR>/<sessionId>.decision.<requestId>.json; requestId = toolCallId with [^a-zA-Z0-9._-]+ replaced by _; sessionId is the CLI session manifest session_id
Answer {approved: boolean, reason?: string}; only approved === true allows; both files deleted after reading

Polls every 200 ms; after 5 min deletes the request and denies 'Tool approval request timed out'; unparseable or half-written decision file is ignored and polling continues, so write it atomically (temp file + rename)
Denied call is skipped with reason + TOOL_REJECTION_SUFFIX returned to the model; run continues; a throwing approval callback denies

--auto-approve false sets the * policy to autoApprove false, but read_files, search_codebase, fetch_web_content, skills, ask_question, ask_followup_question, submit_and_exit stay auto-approved and never reach the approval file
Shell tool run_commands with input {commands: string[]} (lenient union also accepts command/cmd/arrays)
MCP names ${serverName}__${toolName}; if invalid chars or over 64 chars, sanitized, truncated and suffixed _<sha1-8>

SDK plugin fallback: AgentPlugin {name, manifest, setup(api, ctx), hooks: {beforeTool(ctx)}}; beforeTool returns {skip, reason} to block one call, {input} to rewrite, {policy:{autoApprove:false}} to force approval, {stop} to end the run; hook timeout 3 s then plugin degraded and run continues; CLI loads JS/TS plugin modules from ~/.cline/plugins and <ws>/.cline/plugins

File hooks: executable named PreToolUse[.sh|.py|.js|.ts...] in ~/Documents/Cline/Hooks, ~/.cline/hooks (CLINE_DIR), or <ws>/.cline/hooks; JSON on stdin; stdout JSON {cancel, errorMessage, contextModification|context, overrideInput}; timeout 120000 ms
File hook cancel: true maps to stop (ends the whole run), not a per-call skip; overrideInput rewrites input
File hook timeout, invalid JSON, or crash is logged and skipped (fail-open)
